Eve (Marketplace): Heads-up: AWS Marketplace listing for the joint observability bundle needs a short how-to for Datadog + OpenTelemetry integration specifically for Dedicated clusters. Can we avoid recommending anything that requires opening outbound 443 by default?
Theo (Obs PM): We should show two patterns: 1) relay via customer-managed Datadog relay in a DMZ (https outbound), 2) agentless push via on-prem relay that uses a controlled egress (with explicit consent). Avoid prescriptive network changes.
Riko (Solutions Eng): I'll draft both patterns. For airgapped environments we can recommend writing to a local file and using an operator to ship when connectivity is present. Example collector pipeline for relay: ```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc:
      http:
exporters:
  datadog:
    api: ${DD_API_KEY}
  file:
    path: /var/log/otel/out.json
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      exporters: [datadog, file]
```
Samir (SI Lead): For SI installs we need step-by-step: install collector as a daemonset, mount unix socket to runtime containers, verify spans show `inference.generate`. Also include troubleshooting: TLS cert mismatch, port conflict, env var DD_API_KEY absent.
LegalBot: Reminder: Marketplace copy must not promise logs will be sent to Datadog without customer consent. Include opt-in language.
Eve (Marketplace): Good. Riko, can you also provide a short JSON snippet for the marketplace tile that includes the compact 3-panel listing? Keep JSON minimal since tile UI strips long descriptions.
Riko (Solutions Eng): Quick snippet: ```json
{"title":"Redwood Observability Bundle","panels":["latency_pctiles","fallback_rate","error_rate"]}
```
Theo (Obs PM): Also include a link to the full SI playbook and a note: "For air-gapped deployments, follow the SI playbook to configure a local relay."
Samir (SI Lead): We'll validate installer with NovaWorks this week and send results. ETA 4 days.
Eve (Marketplace): Plan: Riko to drop snippets + how-to by EOD, LegalBot to confirm opt-in language, Samir to run installer test and report. Then we submit to AWS marketplace QA.
